formula.attack_selection: damage: physical_mode selects melee/ranged and magical uses MAG/DEF M; affliction: MAG versus target.magic_defense + action.resistance_stat
formula.affliction: 100 * magic_power / (magic_power + target.magic_defense + target[action.resistance_stat]); no probability floor or ceiling
formula.affliction_resistance: target.magic_defense + specific VIG/INT; sum is not capped; samples record specific_resistance, magic_defense and combined_resistance
formula.affliction_resources: zero damage and HP removed; action MP spent on evaded/resisted/applied; no ongoing status simulation
formula.critical_eligibility: physical damage only; magical damage and affliction never critical
formula.evasion_stats: ally: clamp(own evasion_base + equipped armor.evasion_bonus, 0, 100); enemy: direct; missing armor bonus is zero
formula.evasion: direct magical damage ignores EVA; physical damage and afflictions use target.evasion_base when action.evasion_allowed; evaded: zero damage, no critical, action MP still spent
formula.magical_stats: ally: clamp(own magic_power + weapon.magic_attack_bonus, 0, effective_stat_limit); clamp(own magic_defense + armor.magic_defense_bonus, 0, effective_stat_limit); missing bonuses zero; enemy direct
formula.physical_stats: ally: clamp(own stat + equipped bonus, 0, effective_stat_limit); enemy: direct stats
